Kumaraswamy Alleges Karnataka CM Siddaramaiah Knew of Sting Operations

Former Karnataka Chief Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy has claimed that current Chief Minister Siddaramaiah was aware of sting operations being conducted while he was in office and questioned how long Siddaramaiah was being "blackmailed." Kumaraswamy also raised concerns about cabinet secrets leaking to the media, suggesting that the Chief Minister's phone and those of his office staff should be investigated before examining others' devices.
